# Revision 7: specialized 9005 and RAP reference compatibility

This local revision completes the operator-authorized specialized consumer port.
Scientific authority remains Anurag's reference; the operator explicitly chose
“preserve reference. that is anurag's domain”. No claim of Anurag's review is made.
The durable contract is `docs/contracts/specialized-revegetation-consumer.md`;
WEPPpy records rationale and alternatives in ADR-0134.

Native source `e0abe0581f77c6f66917e90daf8f8f429e9315c8` on the verified default
branch preserves revision-6 FC/HK ownership and existing PMET mappings. It binds
all seven 9005 header fields, consumes one restrictive record and adopts the
reference conductivity/layer feedback. Continuous daily/hourly RAP reads six
cover bands per OFE/year and invokes the isolated reference growth/fire sequence.
Routing uses regenerated matched passes without applying RAP again. Single-event
RAP is rejected explicitly. Reference recurring anniversary canopy comparisons, comparison versus
assignment, shared crop root-depth mutation and logarithm domain behavior remain.

The canonical system-gfortran builder produced the matched Linux pair. Required
native gates pass: 1,750 tests, 31 watchlist cases, both host smokes, artifact policy
and ELF/provenance. Two actual twelve-OFE producer-reader cases were subsequently
added; the complete focused reader module passes 27 tests. The 295 compiled
reference/candidate checks include properties and explicit failures as well as
comparisons; counts overlap the full suite and must not be added.

Eight 16-year daily/hourly transformed/untransformed histories have 17,532 unique
finite water rows each and exact observer output parity. Four additional 9005
histories without RAP pass. Six ordinary controls match revision 6 exactly.
Actual installed hill-to-watershed execution and eight post-vendor tests pass.
Complete configured preparation on a supported disposable fork executes 72 hills,
235 OFEs and 35 calendar years, creates 576 declared outputs, and yields 3,004,240
unique finite raw water rows plus six interchange datasets and report readback.
All 1,536 original-project file hashes remain unchanged. Deterministic synthetic
RAP inputs establish engineering coverage, not observed vegetation or calibration.

Three diagnostic reruns read 14 soil headers and 2,940 cover values; all 24 ordinary
outputs match the configured workflow. Normal execution used service identity
and NFS; dense diagnostic tracing timed out on NFS and succeeded with identical
inputs/binary/identity on isolated local disk. Preserve this mount distinction.

The inherited BIGOUT F10.5 disturbance-age field cannot serialize ages of 10,000
days or more. The configured graphics contain 734,107 asterisk cells exclusively
in that field, including summary rows. All other graphics numeric fields and all
emitted water fields are finite. This documented inherited format limit is retained;
water interchange/reports do not consume it. Optional InterceptionStorage is not
emitted by this native water writer and remains null. No universal physical or
conservation claim is made; historical Roads magnitude failure remains unresolved.

The four-page `main-r7.tex` report and `release-identities-r7.tex` were compiled

Only that PDF and the source-free publication manifest are eligible for public delivery.
